recommended_areas.name: Nanshan

recommended_areas.name: Luohu

transport: Use metro as the backbone because major districts are spread out but well connected.
Treat Futian and Nanshan as separate half-day clusters when possible.
If beach or bayfront stops are included, keep the rest of the day light.
bad_weather_fallbacks: Swap bayfront walks and parks for malls, museums, bookstores, and indoor design spaces.
Use major shopping complexes as the main rain-safe anchors.

leisure.pace_note: Shenzhen works best with one modern urban cluster and one scenic or design stop.

family.pace_note: Use one headline theme attraction and keep transit straightforward.

food.pace_note: Pair meals with malls or nearby leisure zones for a low-friction route.

suggested_queries: Sea World Culture and Arts Center
theme.pace_note: Focus on design, contemporary culture, or bayfront modernity as the narrative.

suggestions: Good day for bayfront and urban landmark stops.
Use malls, museums, and indoor cultural venues as the main anchors.
